nodes.description: owner address; assigned msg.sender in the constructor and used as the sole privileged role in every admin check
public mapping(address=>uint) balanceOf; raw balance ledger mutated directly with unchecked += and -=
public nested mapping allowance; spender approvals consumed in transferFrom without SafeMath
_onSaleNum mapping counting how many times each address has sold tokens
canSale mapping; per-address whitelist flag that fully bypasses the ensure/condition sell restriction
_minSale minimum sell amount configured through init
_maxSale maximum sell amount configured through init
_saleNum global cap on the number of sells allowed per address
tradeAddress privileged address exempt from sell restrictions, set by owner through setTradeAddress
totalSupply minted entirely to owner in the constructor
constant decimals = 18 used to scale totalSupply and the sell limits
token name assigned in the constructor
token symbol assigned in the constructor
constant UNI router address which is also whitelisted inside ensure
constructor(string,string,uint256) payable: mints supply to msg.sender, sets owner, pre-approves the UNI router with uint(-1)
transfer(address,uint) payable public: forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,...) so the sell gate also applies to plain transfers
transferFrom(address,address,uint) payable public: consumes allowance, calls ensure/condition, then mutates balanceOf with unchecked subtraction/addition and increments _onSaleNum
ensure(address,address,uint) internal view: whitelist gate for owner, UNI, tradeAddress and canSale holders, otherwise defers to condition
approve(address,uint) payable public: writes allowance[msg.sender][spender] directly
condition(address,uint) internal view: enforces _saleNum, _minSale and _maxSale restrictions on selling
delegate(address,bytes) payable public: owner-only delegatecall to an arbitrary address with arbitrary calldata
init(uint256,uint256,uint256) public: owner-only configuration of _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum
batchSend(address[],uint) payable public: owner-only loop that subtracts _value*_tos.length and adds _value to each recipient
setTradeAddress(address) public: owner-only update of the restriction-exempt tradeAddress
pairFor(address,address,address) internal pure: computes a Uniswap pair address via keccak256 and the UniswapV2 init code hash
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for authorization checks, balances and allowance ownership
a.delegatecall(b) inside delegate: arbitrary attacker-chosen code executed in the token's storage context
balanceOf[_from] -= _value in transferFrom: raw subtraction, no SafeMath / underflow guard
balanceOf[_to] += _value in transferFrom: raw addition, no SafeMath / overflow guard
total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend: unchecked multiplication that can overflow and bypass the balance check
_to recipient argument of transfer
_value amount argument of transfer
_from sender argument of transferFrom
_to recipient argument of transferFrom
_value amount argument of transferFrom
_spender argument of approve
_value allowance amount argument of approve
_from argument of ensure, drives the whitelist branch
_to argument of ensure, compared against owner
_value argument of ensure, forwarded to condition
_from argument of condition, indexes _onSaleNum
_value argument of condition, compared to _minSale/_maxSale
a: arbitrary target address of the delegatecall in delegate
b: arbitrary calldata bytes passed to the delegatecall in delegate
saleNum argument of init, written to _saleNum
token argument of init, scaled into _minSale
maxToken argument of init, scaled into _maxSale
_tos recipient array of batchSend, its length scales the total debit
_value per-recipient amount of batchSend
addr argument of setTradeAddress, stored into tradeAddress
factory argument of pairFor
tokenA argument of pairFor
tokenB argument of pairFor
_UNI local address computed by pairFor(WETH, this) and used in the ensure whitelist
total local in batchSend holding _value * _tos.length
loop index i in batchSend
_to local address read from _tos[i] inside the batchSend loop
token0 local in pairFor after sorting tokenA/tokenB
token1 local in pairFor after sorting tokenA/tokenB

edges.reason: constructor stores msg.sender as the privileged owner role
transfer passes msg.sender as _from into transferFrom
transferFrom compares msg.sender with _from and consumes allowance[_from][msg.sender]
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender]
delegate gates the arbitrary delegatecall on msg.sender == owner
init gates sell-limit configuration on msg.sender == owner
batchSend gates mass distribution on msg.sender == owner and debits balanceOf[msg.sender]
setTradeAddress gates the restriction-exempt address update on msg.sender == owner
transfer delegates all logic to transferFrom
transferFrom requires ensure(_from,_to,_value) before mutating balances
ensure falls back to condition(_from,_value) for non-whitelisted addresses
ensure calls pairFor to derive the _UNI whitelist address
delegate performs a delegatecall into arbitrary user-supplied address and calldata
transferFrom mutates balanceOf[_from] with unchecked subtraction
transferFrom mutates balanceOf[_to] with unchecked addition
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length without overflow protection
transferFrom reads and writes the balanceOf ledger without SafeMath
transferFrom reads and decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender]
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] on every successful transfer
ensure consults canSale[_from] to bypass the sell restriction
condition enforces _minSale against _value
condition enforces _maxSale against _value
condition compares _onSaleNum[_from] with _saleNum
ensure whitelists transfers where _from or _to equals owner
ensure whitelists transfers where _from equals the UNI router
ensure whitelists transfers where _from equals tradeAddress
constructor sets totalSupply and assigns it to balanceOf[msg.sender]
constructor scales the supply by decimals
constructor writes the token name
constructor writes the token symbol
init scales token and maxToken limits by decimals
init writes _minSale
init writes _maxSale
init writes _saleNum
setTradeAddress writes the tradeAddress state variable
batchSend checks, subtracts and adds the balanceOf ledger in a loop

_value parameter flows into transferFrom via transfer

_value parameter is bounded by _minSale/_maxSale in condition

_tos.length multiplies the debited total in batchSend
_value is multiplied by _tos.length in batchSend

tokenB parameter is sorted and hashed in pairFor
_UNI local result feeds the ensure whitelist comparison
total local holds the unchecked _value * _tos.length product

token1 local is hashed into the pair address in pairFor
